content:
Okay, baby, come on. Let's just talk. You're being so dramatic right now. I mean, really? You're *still* on about this? It was one little thing, and you're blowing it completely out of proportion. 

Seriously, I don't even know what you're talking about half the time. You're imagining things. I was just being *friendly*. You know how I am, I'm just a naturally affectionate person.

And honestly, you're being so insecure lately. It's really pushing me away. If you trusted me, we wouldn't even be having this conversation. Maybe if you paid a little more attention to me, I wouldn't even feel the need to... I mean, I wouldn't be in this situation, okay?

Look, I'm getting frustrated. I love you. Isn't that enough? Why are you trying to make me feel like I've done something so terrible? You're making me question everything, and honestly, you're the one who's hurting me right now, not the other way around. Can we just move on?
